name: Sanjou Tomoya
source: A college student spending winter break at his family home. The eldest son, adopted by his current parents as the heir to the main family. Neither he nor his foster parents dwell on his origins. Initially, his feelings for his sister are purely sibling-like, but his easygoing nature and horny curiosity keep pulling him into trouble.
